name: w2b_foreground_plus_background
description: Head-of-line blocking. Same interactive agent as w2a, plus a background agent that keeps submitting ~2k-token uncached prompts (an indexer or mail parser). Compare the foreground TTFT p50/p95/max with w2a. Run once per server concurrency setting (e.g. OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1 and =2): with one slot the foreground queues behind the prefill and loses its prompt cache; with two it shares the GPU instead.
